title: Stolen 120-year-old church bell found discarded in rural Manitoba ditch
description: A heavy church bell stolen from the top of a belfry in rural Manitoba has been found abandoned in a ditch.
text:
A heavy church bell stolen from the top of a belfry in rural Manitoba has been found abandoned in a ditch. RCMP recovered it around 5:30 a.m. Tuesday near the small community of Malonton after receiving a tip from a passerby.

It was stolen from the church during the week leading up to November 14, when the theft was discovered, police said. It appears to be mostly undamaged," said RCMP Const. Merry Ploeg.

Even just recovering it took a few people, so it's quite a heavy piece of history."' The bell, estimated to weigh about 135 kilograms (300 pounds), was somehow removed from a 1½-storey belfry that stands at the back of the Sacred Heart of Jesus churchyard in Manitoba's Interlake region.

มันถูกขโมยจากโบสถ์ในสัปดาห์ก่อนวันที่ 14 พฤศจิกายน. มันดูเหมือนจะไม่เสียหายมากนัก".
